Confirm Post detail can show Reply and Delete on appropriate rows
items.expected: Execution base has plans 11–14 UI/schema; reactions work can target replies.
items.evidence: Merged kylie/delete-button tip; database/migrations/20260728180000_comment_parent.ts present; Reply/Delete UI on PostDetailPage.

items.title: Set, switch, and clear a post reaction
items.precondition: Signed in; Feed shows at least one post
steps: On a Feed post, confirm only the Like control is visible by default
Hover or press Like so heart / haha / wow appear inline
Hover an emoji and confirm it animates (wiggle/bounce)
Select heart — trigger shows heart; heart count becomes at least 1
Select wow — heart count drops; wow is your reaction
Select wow again — reaction clears; counts update
items.expected: One reaction at a time; switch replaces; same emoji clears; counts + viewer emoji visible.
items.evidence: Human interactive session 2026-07-28: Feed reaction trigger + expanded picker screenshots; continue iterations confirmed set/switch UX.

items.title: React on post detail
items.precondition: Signed in on a post detail page
steps: Confirm ReactionBar sits below the post (action row)
Set a like on the post and confirm it persists after reload
items.expected: Post detail post reactions work and persist.
items.evidence: Human session exercised post detail ReactionBar under post container; API PUT/DELETE returns reactionSummary; typecheck/build green.

items.title: React on comments and replies
items.precondition: Signed in on a post with a top-level comment and a reply
steps: React to a top-level comment (set heart)
React to a reply (set haha)
Reload the page and confirm both reactions and counts remain
items.expected: Comments and replies are independently reactable; summaries survive reload.
items.evidence: Comment/reply ReactionBar wired with size=sm and comment reaction routes; summaries embedded on comment list hydrate.

items.title: Touch / expand path can pick non-Like
steps: Without relying on hover alone, open the emoji strip
Select wow
Confirm wow is applied
items.expected: Non-Like reactions are reachable without desktop hover.
items.evidence: ReactionBar supports click-to-expand and press/hold (HOLD_MS) for touch; expanded strip includes all four emojis.
